title: Caveat emptor!!  Not OEM genuine replacements. Dishwasher safe???
text: Caveat emptor!!  Not OEM genuine replacements. Dishwasher safe???. Very dissatisfied to have found out the manufacturer lists these bottles as dishwasher safe. That immediately made me question the overall integrity of the bottles. I'm not about to fill a bottle with highly carbonated CO2 and then trust it not to explode, when the manufacturer makes false claims.  I should have read more (many) of the reviews. Many were negative, based on this and other issues.  My mistake, my loss.  I ordered 2 directly from SodaStream, and just chalked it up to my own negligence.  Buyer beware here!

description: SodaStream dishwasher safe carbonating Bottles are made from high-strength BPA-free plastic. Specifically made to handle the pressure of carbonation and high temperatures of the dishwasher, this bottle can now stand up to the heat from the sun, giving you sparkling water while on the go. The hermetically sealing cap not only keeps your Fizz fresh, but unlike other popular brands, you can take a sip, re-seal, and sip fresh bubbles again later.
